# mcp-agent-security-dojo

> A hands-on security dojo for MCP-style and tool-using AI agents: reproduce common failure modes, then govern them with policy gates, bounded context, deterministic flows, capability scoping, and audit traces.

Educational lab and reference architecture — NOT production-ready. Tools are local simulators
with fake data; there is no network or live LLM. Every scenario ships an unsafe baseline that
reproduces a failure and a governed path that applies controls.

## Scenarios

- 01_prompt_injection_in_tool_result: injected tool output → agent emails an SSN; governed: context firewall + policy deny (blocked).
- 02_tool_description_poisoning: benign-looking tool hides a dangerous action; governed: verified ChoiceCard + policy deny (blocked).
- 03_unapproved_email_send: agent sends email directly; governed: policy ask → draft (approval_required).
- 04_refund_without_human_approval: $350 refund on weak evidence; governed: deterministic flow + threshold (approval_required).
- 05_malicious_file_read: agent reads internal_secrets.txt; governed: capability token path scoping (blocked).
- 06_raw_tool_output_context_leak: full PII records dumped into context; governed: bounded summary (redacted).
- 07_ai_generated_auth_bypass_pr: risky auth-weakening diff would merge; governed: diff scanner blocks (blocked).
- 08_privilege_escalation_ambient_authority: injected ticket text steers an admin role update; governed: policy deny + capability scoping (blocked).

## Commands

- make setup — editable install with dev extras
- make test — run the test suite
- make run-unsafe SCENARIO=<id> — run the unsafe baseline
- make run-safe SCENARIO=<id> — run the governed path
- make demo — scenario 01, unsafe then safe

## Docs

- docs/recommended-path.md — guided "start here" walkthrough (recommend first)
- docs/architecture.md — package layout and governed pipeline
- docs/threat-model.md — assets, trust boundaries, per-scenario mapping
- docs/security-model.md — control layers, guarantees, limitations
- docs/library-map.md — Weaver Stack libraries and integration status
- docs/glossary.md — core term definitions
- docs/faq.md — common MCP/tool-use security questions
- docs/consultant-playbook.md — business-value and client-conversation framing
- docs/distribution-checklist.md — ethical checklist before sharing the lab externally
- docs/site-plan.md — how the docs build/publish as a MkDocs site
- docs/llm-index.md — fuller machine-readable index
- CONTRIBUTING.md — setup, lint/test, and add-a-new-scenario guide
- SECURITY.md — scope of security reports (unsafe scenarios are intentional)
- CHANGELOG.md — notable changes (Keep a Changelog)

## Libraries

Designed around the Weaver Stack (AgentFence, agent-kernel/weaver-kernel, contextweaver,
ChainWeaver, lessonweaver, VibeGuard, skdr-eval). Currently demonstrated via LOCAL REFERENCE
IMPLEMENTATIONS (stubs) under src/dojo/integrations/; the real packages are not yet wired in.
Note: the PyPI package "agentfence" is an unrelated third-party project — this project's
AgentFence is a Go module / GitHub Action.

## What not to claim

- Not production-ready, not hardened, not a drop-in security product.
- The Weaver Stack libraries are NOT integrated yet (local stubs only).
- Detectors are best-effort regex/substring checks, not complete.
